name: Children And Death
overview: Scripture reveals that the death of God's saints, including children, is precious in His sight and is met with divine comfort and healing for the brokenhearted. Jesus' special regard for children, welcoming them into the kingdom of heaven, underscores their value before God. Believers are assured that through faith in Christ, death does not lead to perishing but to everlasting life, offering hope and consolation amid mourning.
